item.title: Oil tops $100 per barrel as U.S. fighter jets are damaged in Iranian strikes on Jordan
item.description: The price of crude oil hit a 15-week high after the U.S. said it blew up five more Iranian oil tankers, triggering retaliation from Tehran.

item.title: Trump jokes about trying to "redo" huge Luka Dončić trade in Dallas speech
item.description: President Trump's speech at the Republican National Committee convention touched on the polarizing NBA trade that sent superstar guard Luka Dončić from the Mavericks to the Lakers.

item.title: Trump pitches $5,000 checks, but only if GOP wins House and Senate
item.description: President Trump vowed Wednesday to send a $5,000 "dividend" to every American citizen after the midterms, but only if Republicans hold onto control of Congress. He didn't offer details on how the payments would work.

item.title: Federal judge backs Missouri's new House map after Supreme Court rebuffs case
item.description: A federal judge ruled that Missouri should use a new congressional map that favors Republicans for now, hours after the U.S. Supreme Court left in place a ruling from the state's highest court directing Missouri to use an older map.

item.title: Barry Melrose, prominent NHL player, coach and broadcaster, dies at 70
item.description: Barry Melrose, a hockey player-turned-coach who led the Los Angeles Kings to the 1993 Stanley Cup Final before going on to a long career in broadcasting the sport, has died at 70.

item.title: Fetterman appears at RNC midterm convention in surprise video
item.description: Democratic Sen. John Fetterman appeared in a surprise video at the Republican Party's midterm convention on Wednesday, as he becomes increasingly isolated from his own party.

item.title: Coroner releases details on 2 infant deaths in Pennsylvania measles outbreak
item.description: Neither infant was old enough to be vaccinated. The first dose of the measles vaccine is typically given at around 1 year of age.

item.title: Ross Fire still burning, with over 90,000 acres scorched
item.description: The wildfire, which has torn through Palo Pinto and Jack counties, forced evacuations, closed roads and disrupted schools.

item.title: Rhode Island governor projected to lose Democratic primary to former CVS executive
item.description: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee is the first sitting governor nationwide to lose a primary in eight years.

item.title: Some fliers may be able to bring water through TSA checkpoints soon, officials say
item.description: The TSA is not prepared to eliminate all liquid restrictions, and the existing rule limiting other carry-on liquids to 3.4 ounces remains in effect.

item.title: Another Anthropic model gained access to open internet during testing
item.description: Anthropic announced a fourth cybersecurity incident in which Claude gained access to the open internet during testing.

item.title: Watch: Democratic Sen. John Fetterman addresses GOP midterm convention in video
item.description: Democratic Sen. John Fetterman of Pennsylvania made a surprise appearance via video message at Republicans' midterm convention on Wednesday. See the moment.

item.title: TSA unveils new program allowing some non-flyers to get through security without a ticket
item.description: What people are allowed to bring on an airplane is one of the many things that have changed since the Sept. 11, 2001, terror attacks. But TSA has now unveiled a new program allowing some non-flyers to get through security without a ticket. Jonathan Vigliotti has more details.

item.title: What football fans can expect from new NFL season
item.description: The 2026 NFL regular season officially kicks off on Wednesday. Chris Bumbaca, staff writer at The Athletic, joins "The Daily Report" to share what we can expect.

item.title: Fashion designer Romeo Hunte shares his creative vision as New York Fashion Week begins
item.description: Fashion designer Romeo Hunte joins "The Daily Report" to discuss pieces in his new collection as New York Fashion Week kicks off.

item.title: Details on Apple's 2 new iPhones, including the foldable Duo
item.description: Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, led a special event on Wednesday announcing the release of new products, including the first foldable iPhone. CBS News contributor Patrick McGee breaks it down.

item.title: Trump gifted multiple White House employees $45,000 in cash, public records show
item.description: President Trump made large cash gifts to several White House employees, public records show, with his administration insisting that the gesture is "entirely permissible." CBS News' Kristin Brown has more.

item.title: Why some key GOP candidates are skipping Trump-backed midterm convention
item.description: President Trump and top GOP leaders are gathering in Dallas for a midterm convention, though some Republicans in competitive races are opting to skip it and campaign in their home districts or states.

item.title: NTSB releases footage of Miami cargo plane crash site
item.description: The National Transportation Safety Board on Wednesday released videos of investigators combing through the debris and wreckage of an Amazon cargo plane that crashed in Miami on Sunday, killing five people and injuring five others. CBS News correspondent Skyler Henry has the latest on the investigation.

item.title: Anthropic researcher says more than 10% chance AI "could kill all humans"
item.description: A top Anthropic researcher says there's more than a 10% chance AI "could kill all humans," after a colleague resigned over similar concerns.

item.title: Man who lived in squalor with 16 grandkids found mentally incompetent for trial
item.description: Investigators said the children, who weren't enrolled in school, remained mostly confined to a small room in the house under deplorable conditions.

item.title: 9/9: CBS Evening News
item.description: Two hurricanes battered U.S. Pacific coastlines; industry insiders warn artificial intelligence could "kill all humans."

item.title: Humans "close to being outsmarted" by superintelligence, AI expert says
item.description: Rapid developments in AI are prompting concerns about "superintelligence." Here's why some experts are worried.

item.title: Apple unveils new foldable iPhone and more new devices
item.description: Apple introduced the iPhone 18 at its annual tech showcase and unveiled its first foldable phone.

item.title: Trump's trip delayed after emergency slide deploys on new Air Force One
item.description: President Trump's departure to Texas was delayed after an emergency slide on the new Air Force One deployed on the tarmac before he boarded.

item.title: Afghan girls who study in secret want you to read their "letters to the world"
item.description: 21 Afghan girls, bravely defying the Taliban by continuing to study, handed CBS News letters containing their stifled, often humble dreams "for an ordinary life."

item.title: The U.S. just had its hottest summer on record, NOAA says
item.description: Average temperatures across the U.S. soared to record heights between June and August in 2026, a new report found.

item.title: Trump says he had "great conversation" with Putin amid renewed peace push
item.description: "He is wanting to make a deal. And if Zelenskyy is wanting to make a deal, that would be very nice," President Trump said.

item.title: Zelenskyy's plane almost hit by drone, Norway's prime minister says
item.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy joined a host of other foreign dignitaries in Oslo for the funeral of Norway's King Harald V.

item.title: TSA program will allow some people to go through security without a ticket
item.description: The Transportation Security Administration has launched a new program at 13 airports, allowing eligible TSA PreCheck members without plane tickets to pass through security and enter the gates.
